program.name: Three-Split 60 Harder Moves II
program.subject: Signature
program.blurb: Three-Split 60 Harder Moves, one level harder: every day starts where the original's Level II did, with the newer moves in the mix.
program.about: The Three-Split 60 rhythm as a new program: chest and back, a full-body day, then abs and cardio. The full-body day alternates an upper and a lower focus, and abs finish every workout. The days and times match Three-Split 60, but it is built fresh, so the exercises are not the same ones. This II is the same program one level up, with the newest moves in the mix, and its Level III adds a set where the day has room.
program.split: Chest & back / full body / abs & cardio
